title: Know When the Equation Is Wrong: Structural Uncertainty for LLM-Guided Symbolic Regression under Extrapolation
abstract: arXiv:2610.42024v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can help discover mathematical equations from data, but most LLM-guided symbolic regression methods focus on a single best equation without quantifying uncertainty over alternative functional forms. This is challenging because distinct equations can fit the observed data similarly while producing substantially different extrapolations. Our experiments on the LLM-SRBench dataset show that standard conformal intervals achieve nominal in-distribution coverage but frequently fail under extrapolation. To tackle this challenge, we introduce LLM-SR-UQ, a framework that retains competing equation structures and uses their disagreement to characterize uncertainty about the underlying functional form. We extend the standard fixed-width conformal approach to quantify structural intervals, which measure disagreement among candidate equations and identify where prediction intervals should widen. translated_title: 知道方程何时出错：外推情形下LLM引导符号回归的结构不确定性
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）可以帮助从数据中发现数学方程，但大多数LLM引导的符号回归方法只关注单一最佳方程，而未对备选函数形式的不确定性进行量化。这项任务具有挑战性，因为不同的方程可以在拟合观测数据方面表现相近，但在外推时却产生显著不同的结果。我们在LLM-SRBench数据集上的实验表明，标准的保形区间虽然能达到名义上的分布内覆盖率，但在外推情形下经常失效。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了LLM-SR-UQ，这是一个保留相互竞争的方程结构、并利用它们之间的分歧来刻画底层函数形式不确定性的框架。我们将标准的固定宽度保形方法加以扩展，以量化结构区间——该区间衡量候选方程之间的分歧，并识别预测区间应当在何处扩大。大量实验表明……
tldr: 该论文提出LLM-SR-UQ框架，通过保留多个相互竞争的方程结构并利用它们之间的分歧量化结构不确定性，扩展了保形区间方法，从而在外推情形下识别LLM引导符号回归中方程预测失效的区域。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces LLM-SR-UQ, a framework that retains competing equation structures and quantifies structural uncertainty through their disagreement, extending conformal intervals to identify where predictions fail under extrapolation in LLM-guided symbolic regression.
